profile.headline: Software Engineer, Foreflight | Boeing & Medevac Test Pilot and Commander | Army National Guard

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintains and Develops Logbook & Tracklog features of Foreflight using JavaScript (React & Node), Java, Python, SQLite

positions.title: Commander, Delta Company - 15D
positions.description:
- Deployed with 185th Expeditionary Combat Aviation Brigade in Support of Operation Inherent Resolve (OIR) to Iraq, Kuwait, Jordan and Syria
     - Commander of Largest Company in Brigade
     - Served as First Up Medevac Pilot
- Aviation Captains Career Course Graduate
- Qualified Maintenance Test Pilot (MTP) UH60M
- Pilot in Command (PC)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Assigned to Research and Development, developed and maintained multiple process efficiency applications using JavaScript, Typescript, SQL Server, PowerShell

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description: Assigned to Customer Service Developer Department, developed and maintained proprietary Customer Relationship management software and Enterprise Resource Planning Software with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server and PHP
